comments.text:
Could you live for an entire summer in the mountains—with no electricity, no running water, and almost no phone signal? 🏔🐎
The Kyrgyz nomads may have fewer modern comforts, but they possess something many people have lost: freedom, community, and a powerful connection with nature.
Do you think they are sacrificing comfort—or living a richer life than the rest of us? Share your opinion below, and tell us which country you’re watching from! 👇🌍
